https://tenor.com/view/mad-tv-mad-tv-darrell-can-i-get-your-number-gif-11972942673977915908

It looks like WMI v10 has been reverted in the wmi_driving repository, and it has gone back to WMI v9.

v9 = v11
So there are no differences between v9 and v11?
Only diff is lat smooth
I guess we will see if that makes a difference

v9 and v11 use the same vision and policy models, but there is a notable change in lateral prediction behavior.
The fixed prediction delay used during lateral planning, LAT_SMOOTH_SECONDS, has been changed from 0.1 to 0.0.
This means lateral response may become tighter and more immediate, potentially resulting in quicker steering reactions compared to v9.
So we won't get that until the sync?
Huh? No lat smooth on our models is all controlled online. It’s not hardcoded here 🙂
It’s all set in the JSON
Ohhhh that's always confused me how that works. That's really cool though. I thought you would have to apply all the commits that made changes to the model stuff but I guess a lot of it is dynamic.
Yup. We control most of the constants per model level dynamically
Where can I see the JSON file
sunnypilot-docs repo

the smoothing change comes across a little weird on my angle steering car. There’s sometimes rapid steering wheel oscillations, sort of like how the steering wheel would vibrate while driving on a dirt road.
